picture-pairs.name: Omafano a faafana
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Oudano wokufaafanifa omafano wovanhu tava lumbu noudu wokudimbwa: Omafano a faafana
picture-pairs.h1: Omafano a faafana: Oudano wombili wokutula omafano kumwe
picture-pairs.description: Oudano woshali wombili wokufaafanifa omafano wovanhu tava lumbu noudu wokudimbwa. Omafano manene ohaa kala e wetike, kape na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga, ndele oto dulu okuhoolola oukalata 4 fiyo 12.
picture-pairs.short: Konga omafano avali a faafana. Omafano otaa dulu okukala e li wetike.
picture-pairs.intro: Nyenya efano, opo nee to nyenye olo la faafana nalo. Omafano ohaa kala e wetike, opo kuha kale sha sha pumbwa okudimbulukwa. Ngeenge omafano avali otaa tu kumwe, ohaa mono omunghulo woshingoldo noshididiliko sheyapulo.
howTo: Hoolola kutya oto longo noukalata vangapi. Oukalata vane ovehovelo liwa li na ombili.
Nyenya efano keshe. Otali mono omunghulo woshingoldo.
Nyenya efano olo la faafana nalo. Omafano avali otaa kala pamwe noshididiliko sheyapulo.
Ngeenge omafano avali kae fi amwe, kape na sha shii tashi ningwa. Nyenya vali efimbo keshe to kala we lilongekida.
Pana "Omafano a holekwa" ashike ngeenge amushe omwa hafela onghedi yonale yomafano a tala pedu.
tips: Tumbuleni mokule omadina omafano pamwe ndele tamu kundafana kombinga yao: "Okakopi kotee katilyana. Oho tula omaele motee yoye?"
Efa omunhu ou to file oshisho oye a nyenye, nonande tashi pula efimbo. Ulika ponhele yokunyenyena ko.
Kaleni noukalata vane efimbo alishe olo tamu mono shiwa. Oukalata vahapu ehoololo ashike, kae fi onghatu oyo mu na okuhanga.
Xulifeni fimbo oshili shihokiye. Oudano umwe ashike oshilonga sha wanina po.

faq.q: Ope na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na oloola, eembinga, okuvalula omalinyengo ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe, nokweefa pokati onghedi iwa lela yokumanifa.

faq.q: Omolwashike omafano haa kala a tala pombada?
faq.a: Okukaleka omafano e wetike otashi ningi oudano u kale wokutala nokufaafanifa ponhele yokudimbuluka. Ovanhu vahapu oveshi wete shi na ombili. Oto dulu okulundululila komafano a holekwa menyenyo limwe ngeenge osho wa hala.

faq.q: Oshoshali ngoo, noonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Ehee, oshoshali, nokape na ombapila yokulishangifa ile okunanghifa mo sha. Ohashi longo mokukonakoni ko-inthaneta kongodi, kootablete ile kokompiyuta.

faq.q: Ohatu dulu okulongifa omafano etu mwene oukwaneumbo?
faq.a: Ehee. Kendeka Photo pairs, oyo hai ku pe omhito yokuhoolola omafano moshikwaelektroniki shoye. Omafano ohaa kala ashike mokukonakoni koye nokaetuminwa ko-inthaneta.

find-the-same.name: Konga olo la faafana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Konga efano la faafana: Oudano upu wovanhu tava lumbu noudu wokudimbwa
find-the-same.description: Efano limwe pombada, avali fiyo ane pedu. Nyenya olo la faafana nalo. Oudano wombili woshali womafano wovanhu tava lumbu noudu wokudimbwa, ka u na efimbo lokuvalula.
find-the-same.short: Tala kefano li li pombada ndele to nyenye olo la faafana nalo pedu.
find-the-same.intro: Efano limwe ole li pombada yokashikwaelektroniki. Pedu lalo ope na omafano avali, atatu ile ane. Nyenya olo la faafana nalo. Oshi li ehoololo lipu limwe lwofimbo, li na omhito ya kola yokupopya.
howTo: Hoolola omafano avali, atatu ile ane oo to hoolola muo. Avali oo mapu unene.
Taleni pamwe kefano li li pombada.
Nyenya efano la faafana nalo li li pedu. Otali didilikwa neshididiliko sheyapulo neendjovo dimwe ditunhula.
Ngeenge panyenywa efano le lili, oudano otau tumbula ashike edina lalo ndele tau teelele. Kape na okululumuka.
Nyenya "Efano tali landula" ngeenge mwe lilongekida vali limwe.
tips: Popyafani kombinga yefano keshe fimbo inamu hoolola: omalwaalo, eembumbo, nopo mwe li monene nale.
Omahoololo avali kae fi "mapu unene". Elalakano olo okukala nefimbo lihokiye, hakukondja.
Ngeenge okunyena okudjuu, omunhu ota dulu okuulika ndele to mu nyenyene ko.

faq.q: Ope na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na oloola, eembinga, okuvalula omalinyengo ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe, nokweefa pokati onghedi iwa lela yokumanifa.

faq.q: Oshike tashi ningwa po ngeenge panyenywa efano lihe fi lo?
faq.a: Kape na sha shii. Kape na okalunga ke na onyanya, omushiyakano mutilyana ile okukakama. Oudano otau tumbula ashike edina lefano la nyenywa ndele tau teelele enyenyo tali landula.

faq.q: Oshoshali ngoo, noonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Ehee, oshoshali, nokape na ombapila yokulishangifa ile okunanghifa mo sha. Ohashi longo mokukonakoni ko-inthaneta kongodi, kootablete ile kokompiyuta.

shadow-match.name: Faafanifa nomudidimbe
shadow-match.seoTitle: Oudano wokufaafanifa nomudidimbe wovanhu tava lumbu noudu wokudimbwa: Woshali ko-inthaneta
shadow-match.description: Omudidimbe mulaula pombada, omafano avali fiyo ane pedu. Nyenya efano olo tali ningi omudidimbe oo. Oudano wombili woshali wokufaafanifa nomudidimbe wovanhu tava lumbu noudu wokudimbwa, ka u na efimbo lokuvalula.
shadow-match.short: Tala komudidimbe ndele to nyenye efano olo tali u ningi.
shadow-match.intro: Okufaafanifa nomudidimbe oshilonga sha shiivika komapapila omadheulo, apa tashi ningwa nomafano manene nopehe na sha shokushikisha. Omudidimbe omuwa ou li pombada yokashikwaelektroniki nomafano avali, atatu ile ane oku li pedu. Nyenya efano olo tali ningi omudidimbe oo. Eembumbo ngaashi okambasikela, okambwela ile okakopi kotee omapu yo okupopyafana kombinga yao.
howTo: Hoolola omafano avali, atatu ile ane oo to hoolola muo. Avali oo mapu unene.
Taleni pamwe komudidimbe. Oumbumbo wao owashike? Oule ile obulungudu?
Nyenya efano olo tali ningi omudidimbe. Edina lalo otali holoka koshi yomudidimbe.
Ngeenge panyenywa efano le lili, oudano otau tumbula ashike edina lalo ndele tau teelele. Kape na okululumuka.
Nyenya "Omudidimbe tau landula" ngeenge mwe lilongekida vali umwe.
tips: Landula omukanka womudidimbe nomunwe ndele tamu kundafana kombinga yombumbo yawo.
Ngeenge omididimbe oda fa didjuu nena, lundululila ko-Konga olo la faafana, oko omafano e li wetike nawa.
Popyafani kombinga yefano ngeenge la monika: "Otwa li tu na okambwela ka fa aka."

faq.q: Ope na efimbo lokuvalula ile eembinga?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na oloola, eembinga, okuvalula omalinyengo ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe, nokweefa pokati onghedi iwa lela yokumanifa.

faq.q: Okufaafanifa eemvudidimbe okuwa tuu kovanhu ve na oudu wokudimbwa?
faq.a: Otashi dulu okukala oshinyangadalwa shiwa nohapu shapu kovanhu vamwe, unene tuu pomahovelo. Oolupe oshipu oku di dimbulukwa shi dulife eendjovo. Osho shokulinyanyudifa nokukundafana, hoshitetelo, nohashi pangele ile shi shonopeke oudu wokudimbwa. Ngeenge otashi handukifa ile tashi nyemateke, kendabala Konga eshi sha faafana ile taleni ashike omafano pamwe.

faq.q: Oshike hashi ningwa po ngeenge efano la puka la finyinikwa?
faq.a: Kape na sha shii hashi ningwa po. Kape na ewi lii, omushiyakano mutilyane ile ekakamo lofilima. Oudano ohau tumbula ashike edina lefano la finyinikwa ndele tau teelele efinyino tali landula.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali, nokape na e-akaunta, okulishangifa ile okukutha ko ko-interneta. Ohashi longo mokukongifo ko-web kongodi, kotableta ile kokompiuta.

sort-together.name: Yoolola pamwe
sort-together.seoTitle: Oudano wokuyoolola wovanhu ve na oudu wokudimbwa: Yoolola pamwe
sort-together.description: Finyina efano, ndele to finyina oshimbale omo li na okuya: mokombifa ile moshikunino, oiimati ile oinamwenyo. Oshinyangadalwa shombili noshali shokuyoolola kovanhu ve na oudu wokudimbwa.
sort-together.short: Tula efano keshe moshimbale shalo: mokombifa ile moshikunino, noikwao vali.
sort-together.intro: Okuyoolola oshi li oshilonga shafiku keshe sha shiivika nawa nohashi shambula, ngaashi okutula po oilandomwa ile okutuwa oikangasho pamwe. Finyina efano, ndele to finyina oshimbale omo li na okukala. Kape na endelelo nokape na epuko.
howTo: Hoolola oshipalanyole: kombifa noshikunino, oiimati noinamwenyo, ile eumbo nelweendo.
Finyina efano. Ohali mono omunghulo wosingo.
Finyina oshimbale omo li na okuya. Efano otali tembuukile moshimbale osho.
Ngeenge oli na okuya moshimbale shimwe, oudano ohau shi popi nombili ndele tau teelele.
Ngeenge omafano aeshe a yoololwa, taleni mo meembale pamwe.
tips: Monghalamwenyo yolela luhapu kape na omanyamukulo a puka. Ngeenge omunhu okwa ti oshikwatelo shokutekela omeva oshi na okukala mokombifa, pula kutya omolwashike. Otashi dulika u mone ehokololo liwa.
Longifa omafano e li etwomonyo leemupopya: "Owa li wa kuna shike moshikunino shoye?"
Okuyoolola oinima yolela, ngaashi eemhindo neendjato ile oombapa komalwaala, oshi li vali oshinyangadalwa shiwa kokule nekoma.

faq.q: Ope na tuu owili yefimbo ile oitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na owili, oitwa, omuvalu weendaba ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama pefimbo keshe, nokukanghamena pokati oshi li onghedi iwa yokumanifa.

faq.q: Omolwashike okuyoolola?
faq.a: Ovanhu vahapu ohava hafele okuyoolola shaashi oshi li ngaashi oshilonga shi na oshilonga nosha shiivika nawa. Oshipu yo okupopya kombinga yomafano eshi tamu twikile.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali, nokape na e-akaunta, okulishangifa ile okukutha ko ko-interneta. Ohashi longo mokukongifo ko-web kongodi, kotableta ile kokompiuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Opasela yefano
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Opasela ipu yomafano kovanhu ve na oudu wokudimbwa: Oitukulwa 4 ile 9
picture-puzzle.description: Opasela yoko-interneta ipu kovanhu ve na oudu wokudimbwa: oitukulwa inene 4 ile 9, efano alishe otali kala li wetike, ndele to finyina oitukulwa ivali opo i pingenafane eenduda.
picture-puzzle.short: Finyina oitukulwa ivali opo i pingenafane fiyo efano la wanina po.
picture-puzzle.intro: Efano liwa ola tetwa moitukulwa ine ile iheyali inene ndele tali vungakanifwa. Efano alishe otali kala li wetike pombada li li ewiliko. Finyina oshitukulwa shimwe, ndele to finyina shikwao, ndele tavi pingenafana eenduda. Inashi pumbwa okukoka ko sha.
howTo: Hoolola efano noitukulwa 4 ile 9. Ine osho ehovelo liwa lingungumanifi.
Tala efano alishe pombada.
Finyina oshitukulwa, ndele to finyina ponhele opo shi na okuya. Oitukulwa ivali otayi pingenafana.
Oitukulwa i li ponhele ya yeleka ohai mono edidiliko liwa kanini.
Ngeenge efano la pwa okuwanifwa po, li hafeleni pamwe, ndele tamu hoolola vali likwao.
tips: Okufinyina oitukulwa ivali opo i pingenafane oshipu unene shi dulife okukoka kovanhu vahapu.
Popya kombinga yefano eshi tali hange: "Opo omwalo mutilyane opo."
Opasela yolela yoiti i na oitukulwa inene 12 fiyo 24 nayo oshinyangadalwa shokolupalwena shiwa unene.

faq.q: Ope na tuu owili yefimbo ile oitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na owili, oitwa, omuvalu weendaba ile ekanifo. Oto dulu okukanghama pefimbo keshe, nokukanghamena pokati oshi li onghedi iwa yokumanifa.

faq.q: Onda pumbwa tuu okukoka oitukulwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Finyina oshitukulwa shimwe, ndele to finyina shikwao, ndele tavi pingenafana eenduda. Osho oshipu unene kukehe ou e na eke tali kakama ile kokakoma kanini.

faq.q: Oshali tuu, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali, nokape na e-akaunta, okulishangifa ile okukutha ko ko-interneta. Ohashi longo mokukongifo ko-web kongodi, kotableta ile kokompiuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Manifa eyeletumbulo
finish-the-saying.description: Omayeletumbulo a shiivika nawa oo a pumbwa oshitya shaxuuninwa, ngaashi "A penny saved is a penny ___". Finyina ehoololo ile ulika exulilo, ndele tamu popi kombinga yaasho.
finish-the-saying.short: Manifeni omayeletumbulo a shiivika nawa pamwe, ndele tamu popi kombinga yao.
finish-the-saying.intro: Omayeletumbulo akulu luhapu ohaa shiivika moukalamwenyo aushe. Okakalata keshe otaka ulike eyeletumbulo la shiivika nawa la pumbwa oshitya shaxuuninwa, omahoololo atatu, nokambola koku "Ulika exulilo". Konima yexulilo, epulo lombili otali mu hiyi komukundafano.
howTo: Lesheni eyeletumbulo mokule pamwe.
Finyina oshitya tashi li manifa, ile finyina "Ulika exulilo".
Lesha vali eyeletumbulo alishe ndele tamu popi kombinga yalo to longifa epulo olo.
Finyina "Eyeletumbulo tali landula" ngeenge mwe lilongekida.
tips: Lesha ngoo kanini ndele to efa po okambuda komwaka komesho yoshitya shaxuuninwa. Luhapu ovanhu ohave shi tumbula fimbo ino mana.
Ngeenge omunhu okwa yandje exulilo la yooloka, li hafele. Omatumbulo amwe omayeletumbulo ohaa yooloka komapata ile komitunda.
Mongudu, omunhu umwe ota lesha ndele aveshe tave li manyene mexulilo.

faq.q: Ope na tuu owili yefimbo ile oitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na efimbo tali talwa, eitwa, okuvalula eenghatu ile okukanifa. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe wa hala, nokukanghama pokati oko evelo liwa lokumanifa.

faq.q: Ongahelipi ngeenge otwa hoolola oshitya shi lili?
faq.a: Oudanau otau holola exulilo lo paushitwe ndele tau twikile neenkundana. Kape na eitwa, nenyamukulo li lili oli li ashike nawa.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, kape na oakaundi, okulishangifa ile okununika sha. Osha longa mefolo lointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.

word-search.name: Okukonga eendjovo meendada dinene
word-search.seoTitle: Okukonga Eendjovo meendada Dinene kOvanhu ve na Oududu wokudimbwa, ta di nyanyangidwa
word-search.description: Oudanau woshali wokukonga eendjovo meendada dinene wovakulunhu novanhu ve na oududu wokudimbwa. Eendjovo dinini, eendada dinene, eendjovo oda yaluka tashi piti lwopexulilo ile kombinga yopedhi ashike. Danau kointaneta ile u nyanyangide.
word-search.short: Eendada dinene, eendjovo dinini, okuya kolulyo nopedhi ashike. Oto dulu yo oku di nyanyangida.
word-search.intro: Okagololo kanini ke na eendada dinene neendjovo ashike dinini, adishe tadi leshwa okuya kolulyo ile kombinga yopedhi. Denga kondada yotete yoshitya, opo nee u denge kondada yaxo yaxuuninwa. Owa hala tuu kombaapila? Nyanyangida oudanau mupe nekwato limwe ashike.
howTo: Hoolola oshipalanyole noulapi wokagololo.
Tala melandulafano leendjovo. Eendjovo otadi leshwa okuya kolulyo (kolumosho okuya kolulyo) ile kombinga yopedhi (kombada okuya pedhi).
Denga kondada yotete yoshitya, opo nee u denge kondada yaxo yaxuuninwa.
Oshitya sha monika otashi ningi oulwaala tau vema ndele tashi dhengwa mo melandulafano.
Denga "Nyanyangida oudanau ou" opo u danawine kombaapila nopenzela ile opena.
tips: Ulikeni oshitya melandulafano ndele tamu kongo pamwe ondada yotete.
Kombaapila, opena yomalwaala oipu okukwata shi dulife openzela.
Popileni eendjovo doshipalanyole. Eendjovo doinyandishwa ohadi pendula noupu omafimbo okulikola, okuteleka ile komalandifilo.

faq.q: Ope na ngoo efimbo tali talwa ile eitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na efimbo tali talwa, eitwa, okuvalula eenghatu ile okukanifa. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe wa hala, nokukanghama pokati oko evelo liwa lokumanifa.

faq.q: Ondi na ngoo oukwatya wokunyanyangida ekongo leendjovo?
faq.a: Heeno. Denga "Nyanyangida oudanau ou" opo u nyanyangide okagololo kopaife meendada dinene, nelandulafano leendjovo koshi yako. Oudanau keshe mupe owe lili.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, kape na oakaundi, okulishangifa ile okununika sha. Osha longa mefolo lointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.

coloring.name: Omafo okutula omalwaala
coloring.seoTitle: Omafo Okutula Omalwaala Ovakulunhu ve na Oududu wokudimbwa (Oshali)
coloring.description: Omafo mapu okupenda ovakulunhu e na eembinga dinene: denga kombinga yelwaala, opo nee u denge pefano. Kape na elunduko, kape na omalwaala a puka, nefo keshe otali dulu okunyingwa oshali.
coloring.short: Denga kelwaala, opo nee u denge kombinga yefano. Oto dulu yo okunyanyangida omafo.
coloring.intro: Omafo e na omalupe manene naapu: onhemo moshiyuma, eumbo, okakopi keeti, embiimbili nowato. Denga kelwaala, opo nee u denge kombinga yefano opo u i yadife. Kape na omalwaala a puka.
howTo: Hoolola efo.
Denga kelwaala. Elwaala keshe ola shangwa edina lalo kulo.
Denga kombinga yefano opo u i yadife nelwaala olo.
Lundulula ediladilo loye efimbo keshe moku i yadifa vali.
Denga "Nyanyangida efo eli" opo u mone efo lihe na sha u li pende neepenzela ile neemakara.
tips: Pa omunhu omalwaala avali opo a hoolole mo ponhele yokumupa aeshe ngeenge okuhoolola otaku shonopeke.
Omiti didilau netango liheeli otai tambulwa ko nawa. Osho sha fimana osho okunyanyukilwa omalwaala, ha okushikula mondjila naanaa.
Omafo a nyanyangidwa ohaa longo nawa neemakara ile neekreiyoni dinene, odo da pupala okukwata.

faq.q: Ope na ngoo efimbo tali talwa ile eitwa?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na efimbo tali talwa, eitwa, okuvalula eenghatu ile okukanifa. Oto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe wa hala, nokukanghama pokati oko evelo liwa lokumanifa.

faq.q: Omafo aa otaa monika tuu oukekembo unene?
faq.a: Otwa shika oinima i ngungumana naipu ponhele yomaweelelo ovashona, opo omafo a kale e wapala ovakulunhu. Omalupe manene otaa ningi okupenda ku pupale ndele kaku fi kwoukanona.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, kape na oakaundi, okulishangifa ile okununika sha. Osha longa mefolo lointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Ookalata deenkundana
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Omapukululo Eenkundana kOvanhu ve na Oududu wokudimbwa: Ookalata dOmafano
conversation-cards.description: Ookalata domafano di na omatukululo eenkundana mapu kuvo ovanhu ve na oududu wokudimbwa: kape na omapulo okuyeleka, kape na omanyamukulo e li mondjila. Longifa koskrena ile u nyanyangide elandulafano alishe.
conversation-cards.short: Ookalata domafano di na omapulo oukwao naapu. Kape na omayeleko.
conversation-cards.intro: Okalata keshe oka kwatakanifa efano li shivike nehiyo la manguluka lokupopya, ngaashi "Onghalo yombepo ilipi u hole unene?" Kape na omanyamukulo e li mondjila ile oshinima sha pumbwa okudimbulukwa. Hoolola oshipalanyole ile u viakanife adishe.
howTo: Hoolola oshipalanyole, ile u kale ashike na "Ookalata adishe".
Lesha epulo mokule ndele tamu tale efano pamwe.
Pwilikina, popya nenyamukulo loye, ndele tamu efa eenkundana di pite ngaashi da hala.
Denga "Okalata tai landula" ngeenge mwa longekida, ile mu kale pokalata imwe efimbo lile ngaashi mwa hala.
Denga "Nyanyangida ookalata adishe" opo mu nyanyangide kombaapila ndele tamu kelele po.
tips: Nyamukula yo epulo kwoove mwene. Osho otashi monika ngoo eenkundana, ha epulopulo.
Shikula ehokololo, haoukwatya woitya. Ngeenge oinima oya lunduluka, osho oshi li ashike nawa.
Ngeenge okalata oka kumu oshinima tashi nyikifa oluhodi, dimina omaliudo ndele tamu lundulukile nokanghenda kokalata imwe.

faq.q: Omolwashike kuhe na omapulo ngaashi "Owa dimbulukwa tuu…"?
faq.a: Omapulo taa yeleke edimbuluko otaa dulu okukala ngaashi ekonakono nokweetifa efiyo lonyalo. Omapulo a yeuluka ngaashi "Lombwele nge kombinga ya..." otaa efa keshe umwe a kufe ombinga, kashi na nee mbudi kutya oshike e shii.

faq.q: Ondi na ngoo oukwatya wokunyanyangida ookalata?
faq.a: Heeno. "Nyanyangida ookalata adishe" ohashi nyanyangida omusholondondo aushe meendada dinene, ookalata dihapu mefo limwe, da longekidilwa okutetwa mo.

faq.q: Oshi li ngoo oshali, nonda pumbwa tuu okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshali ashike, ndele kapu na omhumbwe yeakaundi, yokulishangifa ile yokundownloada. Ohashi longo mobrowser yointaneta mongodi, motableta ile mokompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Omafano a faafana
photo-pairs.h1: Omafano A Faafana: Faafanifa Omafano Oye Mwene
photo-pairs.description: Ningeni omafano eni oukwanoombwambwanahambo oudano umbweletele wokufaafanifa. Hoolola omafano 2 fiyo 6 mokalukalwa koye; otaa kala ashike mobrowser yoye noihaa tuminwa kointaneta.
photo-pairs.short: Hoolola omafano oye mwene ndele to a faafanifa. Kape na sha tashi tuminwa kointaneta.
photo-pairs.intro: Hoolola omafano avali fiyo ahandatu mongodi yoye, motableta ile mokompiuta, ndele taa ningi oudano wokufaafanifa u na omafano manene taa monika nawa. Omafano otaa ulikwa ashike mepandja eli. Ihaa tuminwa kointaneta, ihaa tuvikilwa ile okupewa vamwe, nohaa kana po ngeenge wa pata epandja.
howTo: Kanya opo pa shangwa "Hoolola omafano" ndele to hoolola omafano avali fiyo ahandatu.
Efano keshe otali holoka lwovali. Kanya limwe, ndele to kanya olo la faafana nalo.
Popyeni kombinga yefano keshe eshi mwe li mona.
Ngeenge mwa mana, pata epandja ile u kanye "Dima po omafano". Kape na sha tashi tuvikilwa.
tips: Hoolola omafano taa yele nawa oiina iwa nonghalo ya shiivika: oshinamwenyo sheumbo, oshikunino, onhele ya holoka unene, ile efiku lohango.
Omafano eenele noyoikulunima otaa dulu okukala mupu e dulife oipala yovanhu, nohaa kaleke kokule efininiko lokutumbula omamina ovanhu.
Efe po omafano ovanhu ovo va fya ngeenge otaa dulu okweeta oluhodi lwombaadada, kakele ashike ngeenge ou shi shii kutya ohaa eta ehekeleko.

faq.q: Mbela omafano ange ohaa tuminwa konhele yonhumba kointaneta?
faq.a: Ahowe. Epandja ohali lesha omafano oo wa hoolola mondjila yointaneta yoye mwene ndele tali a ulike kosikilini yoye. Ihaa tuminwa kufye ile komunhu umwe e lili, nohaa kana po ngeenge wa pata ile wa tungulula epandja.

faq.q: Mbela oku na o-ola yefimbo ile oimoniwa yoinshingifo?
faq.a: Ahowe. Kape na o-ola, kape na oinshingifo, kape na okulesha omatando, nokape na ekano. Oto dulu okukanghama pomhito keshe, nokukanghama pokati ondjila iwa yo vene yokumanifa.

faq.q: Mbela ohandi dulu okutuvikila oudano opo tu dane vali oshikando tashi landula?
faq.a: Ahowe mobrowser, oshoka osho sha longekidwa opo kuha tulwe oinima yopaumwene mefilikilo. Okanghalo koshali kaGolden Moments ko-iPhone no-iPad otaka dulu okutuvikila omapeko omafano a hoololwa mokalukalwa koye.

picture-bingo.name: Obingo yomafano
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Obingo Yomafano yOvakulupe ve na Oududu wOkudimbwa: Tai Nyangidwa
picture-bingo.description: Obingo yomafano yoshali tai dulu okushangululwa yeengudu dovakulupe novanhu ve na oududu wokudimbwa, i na omwiifi ta monika nawa kosikilini. Omafano manene a shangwa eendjovo, eembinga 9 ile 16, kapu na omhumbwe yokulesha.
picture-bingo.short: Oukalata vobingo yomafano tava nyangidwa nomwiifi wokosikilini inene weengudu.
picture-bingo.intro: Obingo yashikwa i na omafano ponhele yeenomola, opo kapu kale omunhu a pumbwa okulesha outumbulo vanini. Nyangida oukalata va yoolokafana, ndele to longifa omwiifi wokosikilini okuulika efano keshe li li linene kotelevisi, kokompiuta ile kotableta.
howTo: Hoolola eembinga 9 ile 16 kokalata keshe nomuvalu wovadani.
Kanya "Nyangida oukalata". Okalata keshe oka yooloka.
Patulula omwiifi kosikilini inene. Kanya "Efano tali landula" okuulika efano keshe nedina lalo.
Ovadani otava tuvikile efano la faafana kokalata kavo noshimaliwa shoshingeveli, okambate ile oshimaki.
Keshe omunhu ta yadifa omukweyo ile okalata alishe ota pewa olupandu. Kapu na ou ta pondolwa moudano ou: twikileni okudana fiyo keshe umwe a mona omukweyo.
tips: Longifeni oinima inene ngaashi eembate domashako ile oinima yokudanifa inene. Oumbate vanini otava dulu okukala vidjuu okutoolwa po.
Tumbula efano ndele to popi ko sha kombinga yalo: "Oshikepa yomhepo. Olyelye a li nale moshikepa?"
Kuutumbikeni ovo ve na oudjuu wokumona popepi nosikilini, ndele tamu tula ovakwafi pamwe novadani ovo ve va pumbwa.
Eembinga omugoyi odha wana nawa keengudu dihapu. Kalekeni efimbo lokudana li fike popepi nominute 20 fiyo 30.

faq.q: Ongahelipi handi dulu okudanifa obingo yomafano meumbo lefiloshisho?
faq.a: Nyangida okalata kamwe komudani keshe, tula omwiifi kosikilini inenene oyo u na, ndele to ifana omafano kashona nakashona to tumbula edina la keshe limwe. Daneni fiyo keshe umwe a mona omukweyo, opo kuha kale nande oumwe a fiwa po.

faq.q: Mbela oku shi nyangida oshali?
faq.a: Heeno. Nyangida oukalata vahapu ngaashi we va pumbwa, olwovali ngaashi wa hala, okulongifa pwoye mwene ile mongudu.

faq.q: Mbela ovanhu otava dulu okudana kave na okulesha?
faq.a: Heeno. Okambinga keshe oke na efano linene, nedina lalo koshi yalo kwoovo ve hole eendjovo.

calm-breathing.name: Okufuda kombili
calm-breathing.description: Efudifo li na engungumano nombili lokuhanafanwa: okangulupele kamwenyo ohaka kulu nokashonopa lwoikando ihamano yokufuda. Ove to ka tameke, nooto dulu okukanghama efimbo keshe.
calm-breathing.short: Okangulupele kananghali kokufuda pamwe nako. Tameka ndele to kanghama ngeenge wa hala.
calm-breathing.intro: Omafimbo amwe oshilonga shiwa unene okukanghama mombili. Kanya "Tameka", ndele to fuda meni omhepo eshi okangulupele taka kulu, ndele to fuda mo eshi taka shonopa. Hoolola okuya kashona ile mbala. Haepango li na sha nouhaku, ashike omhito yombili yokulongifa pamwe.
howTo: Kuutumbeni nonghalo iwa pamwe.
Hoololeni ondapo: kashona ile nawa noudede.
Kanya "Tameka". Fuda meni ofimbo okangulupele taka kulu, ndele to fuda mo ofimbo taka shonopa.
Ohaka kanghama ko kovene konima yoikando ihamano yokufuda, ile u kanye "Kanghama" efimbo keshe wa hala.
tips: Kwatelafaneni komaoko ile u tule eke koluoko lomunhu oo to file oshisho ngeenge osho tashi mu hafifa.
Ino fininika nande. Ngeenge okwa hala ashike okutala, osho oshiwa.
Ngeenge omunhu oku na oudjuu wokufuda, nafude ngaashi shito ndele ta tale ashike kokangulupele. Puleni ndohotola kombinga youdjuu keshe wokufuda.

faq.q: Mbela eli edeulo louhaku wokufuda?
faq.a: Ahowe. Eli efudifo lipu lompito yokukala mombili noluhafo lokukala pamwe. Kaushi epango lehandukilo ile loukolele wonhumba. Popyeni nandohotola kombinga yoiponga ile yomaliudo e na sha noukolele.

faq.q: Mbela okangulupele ohaka linyenge ndele ame inandi ka tameka?
faq.a: Aaye. Kape na oshinima tashi linyenge fiyo to fininika Start, ndele otashi kankama konima yomafudho 6 ile ngeenge to fininike Stop. Ngeenge oshikwaelektronika shoye osha tulwa opo shi shonopaleke omalinyengo, eendjovo otadi lunduluka nopwahe na ongonga tai kulu.

faq.q: Oshi li tuu oshali, ndele onda pumbwa okulishangifa?
faq.a: Heeno, oshi li oshali, no kape na oakaunda, okulishangifa ile okundaunloda. Otashi longo mebrowser yointaneta mongodi, motablet ile mokompiuta.
